commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Cormela, Glamour Thief ({1}{U}{B}{R}, 2/4 haste) taps for {U}{B}{R} usable only on instants and sorceries. When she dies, she returns an instant or sorcery from the graveyard. The deck uses that restricted mana for rituals, tutors and cantrips. It turns the mana unrestricted with converters (Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, Culling the Weak, Seething Song, Jeska's Will; the candidate adds Frantic Search). It loops her death trigger with Saw in Half, Molten Duplication (and now Twinflame), Demonic Gifts, Shallow Grave and Goryo's Vengeance, plus Ashnod's or Phyrexian Altar, into infinite storm for Tendrils or Brain Freeze. Thassa's Oracle with Demonic Consultation or Tainted Pact, and Underworld Breach + LED + Brain Freeze, are backup lines.
protected_core: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 5 (cEDH). 20 Game Changers, all unchanged; none of the five adds is a Game Changer. Infinite combos per Commander Spellbook: Cormela + Saw in Half + ritual; Cormela + Demonic Gifts/Goryo's/Shallow Grave + altar; Cormela + Birgi + Molten Duplication or Twinflame; Dualcaster + Molten Duplication/Twinflame/Saw in Half; Thassa's Oracle + Consultation/Pact; Breach + LED/Petal + Brain Freeze.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Every add serves Cormela's restricted mana or her death trigger, or protects the turn she combos: a converter, a second copy loop, uncounterable lands and spells. Generic cEDH staples (Ragavan, The One Ring, Grim Monolith, Mana Drain, fetch eight) were rejected on Cormela-specific grounds. This keeps the deck distinct from the Anhelo and Cecily UBR spellslingers.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps:
All 99 library cards were reviewed by quantity (99 rows, all 1x; Island, Mountain and Swamp x1 each).
Roles:
- 30 lands.
- Fast mana: Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Lotus Petal, LED, Arcane Signet, three Talismans.
- Rituals and converters (Dark Ritual, Cabal Ritual, Culling the Weak, Rite of Flame, Seething Song, Jeska's Will).
- 7 tutors.
- Death-loop pieces.
- 10 counters, plus Pyroblast and REB.
- Draw: Necropotence, Ad Nauseam, Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, wheels and cantrips.
Overlaps: REB/Pyroblast, three sorcery cantrips plus Gitaxian Probe, and two loot effects.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline: 30 lands; average nonland MV 1.841. Heuristic land sources: U 19, B 18, R 17 (fetches counted by their basic types only; all seven can reach U/B/R duals). Candidate: 30 lands; average nonland MV 1.899; sources U 19, B 17, R 16. One always-tapped land (Undercity Sewers) is replaced by Mistrise Village, which enters untapped with any of 5 Mountain-typed lands. Instant/sorcery count 46 -> 45; creatures 5 -> 6.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Force of Will, Force of Negation, Fierce Guardianship, Pact of Negation, Mindbreak Trap, Flusterstorm, Swan Song, Mental Misstep, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Pyroblast and Deflecting Swat, plus Hexing Squelcher and Mistrise Village as proactive protection. Removal: Chain of Vapor, Otawara, Saw in Half, Orcish Bowmasters. Weak points: graveyard hate (Breach, reanimation, Cormela recursion), Stifle effects on death triggers, Cursed Totem against Cormela's mana ability, and artifact hate against the fast mana.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC cEDH page 28/100 (Lands); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Blue land that enters untapped with a Mountain; {U},{T}: the next spell we cast this turn can't be countered.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Undercity Sewers' U/B and its surveil 1. Sewers always enters tapped, and it is the only always-tapped land in the list.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Cormela's win turn hinges on one spell resolving (Ad Nauseam, Underworld Breach, Saw in Half on Cormela, Tendrils). Village makes that spell uncounterable without a card. Five Mountain-typed lands, all reachable by the seven fetches, let it enter untapped.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Blue only, so the deck gives up a black source, and its uncounterable mode costs {U} plus the land's own mana.
material_candidates.reason: Replaces the deck's only always-tapped land with an untapped land that protects the combo turn.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC cEDH page 40/130 (Lands); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Untapped U/B painland that guarantees both of Cormela's heaviest colors.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Exotic Orchard's any-color mana. Orchard depends on opponents' lands, which in cEDH are usually fetches and duals, but it can still miss early or against colorless or mono-color mana.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Cormela needs exactly {1}{U}{B}{R} on turn 2-3. A guaranteed U/B land keeps both of her heaviest colors available.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Deals 1 damage on colored use, in a deck that already pays a lot of life (Necropotence, Ad Nauseam, Mana Confluence, the Talismans).
material_candidates.reason: A guaranteed two-color land over a conditional one. It does not compete with the seven fetches for the remaining fetch targets.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC general page 2030/3891, cEDH page 35/130; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Three-mana instant: draw two, discard two, untap up to three lands.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Faithless Looting's one-mana loot and its flashback. Looting is card disadvantage (draw 2, discard 2, with nothing back) and sorcery-speed.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Cormela-specific converter. Cast with her restricted {U}{B}{R}, Frantic Search untaps three lands, so that restricted mana becomes unrestricted land mana for artifacts, creatures or her own {1} activation. With three lands it is free. Its discards fill the graveyard for Reanimate, Goryo's Vengeance, Shallow Grave, Underworld Breach and Cabal Ritual threshold. It is an instant that Cormela's death trigger can return.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Three mana up front without Cormela or three untapped lands. It is not a loop converter in the Saw in Half line (it nets 0 mana where Dark Ritual nets +2), so it adds no infinite combo.
material_candidates.reason: Turns the commander's restricted mana into unrestricted mana and loots at no net cost. Faithless Looting does neither.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC cEDH page 64/130 (Sorceries); Commander Spellbook 147-1235 and 392-1235-4867; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Two-mana sorcery: hasty token copy of a creature we control, exiled at end step.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Gitaxian Probe's free cantrip, its peek at a hand and +1 storm count for 2 life.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Cast on Cormela, the legend rule kills the original. Her death trigger returns Twinflame, and the untapped hasty token taps for another {U}{B}{R} that recasts it. That is +1 storm and +1 death per loop at net 0 mana, and with Birgi it is infinite (Spellbook 392-1235-4867). With Dualcaster Mage it is a 2-card infinite of hasty tokens (147-1235). It is a second copy of the Molten Duplication plan that Cormela's restricted mana can pay for. On a tapped Cormela it is also +2 net restricted mana.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: A sorcery, so it can only be used on our own main phase. It needs a creature in play, so it is dead without Cormela, Dualcaster or Thassa's Oracle on board.
material_candidates.reason: It adds two Spellbook combos built around the commander and backs up Molten Duplication. Probe's free cantrip is the most replaceable cheap spell in the list.

material_candidates.source: EDHREC cEDH page 33/52 (synergy 0.52); live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: Two-mana uncounterable creature: our spells can't be counted; our other creatures gain Ward—Pay 2 life.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Red Elemental Blast, the second one-mana blue hoser. Pyroblast stays and does the same job more flexibly.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: It makes the whole Cormela combo turn uncounterable: every Saw in Half, Twinflame, ritual and Tendrils copy-maker. It gives Cormela Ward—Pay 2 life against targeted removal. It is also sacrifice fodder for Culling the Weak (MV 2 -> {B}{B}{B}{B}), Diabolic Intent, Phyrexian Tower and the altars.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Dies to removal and wipes. It does not stop Stifle effects on storm or death triggers, or 'can't cast' hatebears. It reduces REB/Pyro coverage against blue counter wars when we are not comboing.
material_candidates.reason: A permanent answer to counterspells on our own turn beats a second one-shot blue hoser. The deck keeps ten free or cheap counters for defense.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Selected five-swap package: an untapped protection land, a guaranteed U/B land, a restricted-mana converter, a second Cormela copy loop, and combo-turn counter protection. Lands stay at 30.

Four-swap package without Hexing Squelcher (staged data/grixis/m7/research_challengers/Cormela__Glamour_Thief_four_without_HexingSquelcher_20261023.txt). Rejected: Red Elemental Blast is redundant with Pyroblast, while Squelcher protects every spell on the combo turn.

Pass C variant: preferred five plus Muddle the Mixture over Seething Song (staged data/grixis/m7/research_challengers/Cormela__Glamour_Thief_six_PassC_Muddle_over_SeethingSong_20261023.txt). Rejected: it loses a converter and Spellbook 500-4036-4867.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C held Seething Song against Muddle the Mixture and found no cut for Abrade. Muddle over Song was re-staged and rejected again. Abrade is staged against Preordain, the lowest-inclusion cantrip, as a retained alternative.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Cormela's mana is restricted, yet the baseline had only one-shot rituals as converters. It ran one always-tapped and one conditional land, used card-disadvantage looting, and had a second blue hoser where a creature protecting every spell on the combo turn fits better.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Five swaps: two lands (untapped, protection; guaranteed U/B), a converter loot (Frantic Search), a second commander copy loop (Twinflame, two new Spellbook combos), and combo-turn protection (Hexing Squelcher). All 23 baseline Spellbook combos are kept.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Commander first, then 1x lines alphabetically (basics Island, Mountain and Swamp x1 each). Five substitutions against the canonical source. 30 lands; 100 physical cards verified by quantity (99 library + 1 commander); 100 unique names (Tainted Pact unaffected).

owner_authority.owner_approval_question: This deck is complete. Do you approve it?

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the five swaps, every remaining incumbent was re-read against the candidate pool. Seven post-floor challenges were recorded: two retained alternatives staged as complete 100s (Abrade over Preordain; Burnt Offering over Windfall) and five rejected on Cormela-specific grounds.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Abrade kills Cursed Totem, Null Rod, Collector Ouphe, Grafdigger's Cage, Drannith Magistrate or Grand Abolisher, but Chain of Vapor and Otawara already bounce them, and Preordain is a one-mana sorcery that Cormela's mana can cast.
Burnt Offering sacrifices Cormela for four unrestricted mana plus her death trigger, but Windfall's refuel and Bowmasters damage is unique, and the deck already has four sac outlets.
Muddle counters a spell and transmutes for Twinflame or Breach, but Song is a converter and a Spellbook-listed infinite with Saw in Half.
Drain counters anything and makes mana, but UU is hard to hold with 19 U sources, and Swan Song costs one.
Monolith gives three colorless mana, but Cormela needs U, B and R, and Monolith adds a Game Changer.
Amber is permanent mana, but only with a legend in play. Petal works on turn one and in the Breach + Brain Freeze combo.
Grid protects our turn, but it taxes our own off-turn counters. Squelcher already protects the combo turn.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: A main-deck answer to Cursed Totem, Null Rod, Collector Ouphe, Grafdigger's Cage and the creature hatebears, which shut off Cormela or the fast mana.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: The bounce suite (Chain of Vapor, Otawara) and Saw in Half already cover those hate pieces, and Preordain keeps the cantrip density.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Burnt Offering is a second Cormela sacrifice-for-mana instant, and Abrade answers hate.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Windfall's refuel plus Bowmasters damage is unique, the sac-outlet count is already four, and the Abrade half is unselected as above.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at five; the five-swap floor was not used as a target. The remaining weak-looking slots each lose to their best challenger on deck-specific grounds: cantrip density castable with restricted mana (Preordain), unique refuel plus Bowmasters damage (Windfall), converter and combo piece (Seething Song), cheap holdable counters (Swan Song, Mental Misstep), color fixing (Talisman of Creativity), and turn-one fast mana (Lotus Petal).
